title: Hair Fall
summary: Nourish the scalp and look for the cause
ayurvedicView: Hair fall is linked to excess Pitta and Vata. Stress, poor diet, illness and hormonal changes are common triggers, so finding the cause matters.
remedies: Warm coconut or sesame oil massaged into the scalp once or twice a week, washed off after an hour
Curry leaves warmed in coconut oil as a hair oil
Amla eaten fresh or as juice
Protein- and iron-rich foods: dals, leafy greens, nuts and seeds
Gentle combing, and avoiding tight hairstyles and hot styling tools
tips: Normal shedding is up to about 100 hairs a day
Hair often falls more for a few months after illness, childbirth or stress, then recovers
Be patient: new growth takes months
seeDoctor: Sudden round patches of hair loss, or hair falling out in clumps
Hair loss with tiredness, weight change or irregular periods (thyroid and iron can be checked)
Scalp pain, redness, scaling or scarring
Hair loss after starting a new medicine
